# shoehorn_forge_approval_policy (Resource)

Manages a Shoehorn Forge approval policy. Needs an admin API key with the `forge:admin` scope; personal access tokens can't hold it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Two-step approval for production changes.
resource "shoehorn_forge_approval_policy" "production" {
  name        = "Production changes"
  description = "Platform lead signs off, then one person from security"
  enabled     = true

  steps = [
    {
      name           = "Platform lead"
      approvers      = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com"]
      required_count = 1
    },
    {
      name           = "Security"
      description    = "Any one security reviewer"
      approvers      = ["carol@example.com", "dave@example.com"]
      required_count = 1
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the approval policy.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The approval chain steps in the policy workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the approval policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the approval policy is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the approval policy.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `approvers` (List of String) The list of approver identifiers for this step.
- `name` (String) The name of the approval step.

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the approval step.
- `required_count` (Number) Number of approvers required. 0 means all must approve.
